intro: Hyderabad blends Nizami heritage with a fast-growing tech scene, and rewards visitors with forts, bazaars and great food. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
tour_note: Check the tour page for which entry tickets are included.

notes: Metro is fast and clean: Red, Blue and Green lines, 57 stations, trains every ~4 min.
Metro fares run from ₹10 to about ₹60 end to end.
TSRTC buses are cheap but crowded; routes are shown in English too.
Ola and Uber work well; cabs cannot be hailed on the street.
Auto-rickshaws need a fare agreed first; minimum ₹20 for 1.6 km, then about ₹11/km.
Driving is for the brave; traffic jams are common at rush hour.

charminar.name: Charminar
charminar.price_text: ≈ INR 25 for Indians, higher for foreign visitors — check on the day
charminar.tip: Climb the minaret early morning to avoid crowds and heat. The bazaar lanes around it are as good as the monument.

golconda.name: Golconda Fort
golconda.price_text: ≈ INR 25 Indians, ≈ INR 300 foreign visitors — check on the day
golconda.tip: Wear sturdy shoes and carry water; the climb to the top takes about an hour. Clap under the entrance dome to hear the echo.

mecca-masjid.name: Mecca Masjid
mecca-masjid.hours: Daily, closed to tourists during prayer times
mecca-masjid.tip: Dress modestly and cover your head; women should carry a scarf. Photography inside the prayer hall is limited.

jalavihar.name: Jalavihar
jalavihar.price_text: Entry fee varies by ride package — check on the day
jalavihar.tip: A water park best for families with kids; bring swimwear and a change of clothes. Confirm opening hours before you go.

ramoji.name: Ramoji Film City
ramoji.price_text: Day packages roughly INR 1,200–3,000 depending on inclusions — check on the day
ramoji.tip: Book online in advance and take the full-day package; it is far from the city so plan a whole day.

snow-world.name: Snow World
snow-world.price_text: Entry roughly INR 500–800 with gear — check on the day
snow-world.tip: Warm jackets and boots are provided; go on a weekday to skip long queues.

wonderla.name: Wonderla (Hyderabad)
wonderla.price_text: Full-day ticket roughly INR 1,000–1,600 — check on the day
wonderla.tip: Buy tickets online for a discount and arrive at opening; lockers cost extra.

laad-bazaar.name: Laad Bazaar
laad-bazaar.price_text: Free to browse; bangles from a few hundred INR
laad-bazaar.tip: Haggle politely for bangles and pearls. Try the local sweets from nearby stalls.

hussain-sagar.name: Hussain Sagar Lake promenade
hussain-sagar.price_text: Free to walk; boat rides cost extra
hussain-sagar.hours: Promenade open daily; boat rides daytime to early evening
hussain-sagar.tip: Walk the Tank Bund at sunset for the Buddha statue views. Skip boat rides on windy days.

birla-mandir.name: Birla Mandir
birla-mandir.tip: Built of white marble on a hill; go at dusk for city views. Shoes and phones are not allowed inside.

salar-jung.name: Salar Jung Museum
salar-jung.price_text: ≈ INR 20 Indians, higher for foreign visitors — check on the day
salar-jung.tip: See the musical clock in the central hall on the hour. Allow at least two hours for the collection.

chowmahalla.name: Chowmahalla Palace
chowmahalla.price_text: Entry roughly INR 100–200 — check on the day
chowmahalla.tip: The Nizam's palace courtyards are photogenic; combine with Charminar nearby.

biryani-food-walk.name: Hyderabadi biryani food walk
biryani-food-walk.tip: Try dum biryani with mirchi ka salan and a plate of haleem in season. Ask your hotel for a trusted local spot.

kbr-park.name: KBR National Park walk
kbr-park.price_text: Small entry fee — check on the day
kbr-park.hours: Daily early morning to early evening
kbr-park.tip: A green walking trail in the city; go early morning for birds and cooler air.

golconda-bazaar.name: Evening walk in the old city lanes
golconda-bazaar.tip: Wander the lanes between Charminar and Mecca Masjid for street food and shops. Keep valuables close in crowds.

necklace-road.name: Necklace Road and Eat Street
necklace-road.price_text: Street food roughly INR 100–300 per item
necklace-road.tip: Come hungry for the food stalls along the lake. Weekends are busy; go on a weekday evening.

stays.why: Central and leafy. Close to good restaurants, malls and the road to Golconda. Easy for first-timers.
Upscale dining and nightlife. Quiet streets, good for couples and business travellers.
Modern hotels near the tech offices. Good metro links, but far from the old city sights.
Near the railway station and airport road. Cheaper rooms and a real local feel.

food: Try Hyderabadi biryani: dum-cooked rice with mutton or chicken. Portions are big; one plate often feeds two.
Haleem is the Ramadan favourite, but many places sell it year-round. Slow-cooked wheat and meat, served hot.
Irani chai and Osmania biscuits at old cafés in the old city. Cheap and a local ritual.
Street snacks: mirchi ka salan, lukhmi and samosas near Charminar. Eat where locals queue.
Vegetarian thalis and Andhra meals are easy to find. Ask for less chilli if you are not used to heat.
more_time: Add a day for the Salar Jung Museum and Chowmahalla Palace in the old city.
Ramoji Film City is a full day out. Check tour times and ticket prices on the day.
Swap one city day for a trip to Golconda Fort at sunset, then dinner in Banjara Hills.
